mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 66 degrees with overcast skies at Harriet Park. The first quarter moon will be joined by a visible pass of the ISS starting at 7:37 PM, rising in the West Northwest over Cross Plains and heading toward Madison near Home Depot. The overnight low will be 57 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The Verona Police Department is currently seeking new patrol officers for a variety of roles including the K9 and drone teams. Additionally, the City of Verona has officially adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan to guide long-term growth.

There is plenty to do, with Yoga at Insight Wellness happening today and Hop Haus Trivia taking place tonight. Tomorrow features live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company, followed by the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival starting this Friday.
On September 10, police responded to a report of a burglary at 600 Hunters Cove Way, where a suspect was taken into custody following a discharge of a firearm.
Culver's of Verona is closed for a remodel today, so be sure to check back for updates on when they will be serving your favorite treats again.
